comment: The upstream files this port reproduces, hashed at trackedRef. Regenerate with: sh scripts/check-upstream-drift.sh --update. A file recorded as GONE does not exist at trackedRef; it is listed because the port must eventually cover it.

src/agent/index.ts.why: the run lifecycle: snapshot before, no-op decision, metadata write after

src/agent/repository-prompts.ts.why: createRepositoryPlannerPrompt and createRepositoryPagePrompt, reproduced in commands/wiki.md Step 3 and SKILL.md

src/agent/utils.ts.why: git-evidence commands, getUpdateNoopStatus, and the .last-update.json shape used by commands/wiki.md and hooks/openwiki-gate.sh

src/agent/wiki-finalizer.ts.why: prepareWikiForAuthoring / finalizeWikiArtifacts lifecycle, reproduced by the two modes of scripts/openwiki-finalize.py

src/agent/wiki-link-validator.ts.why: validateWikiInternalLinks, reproduced by pass 3 of scripts/openwiki-finalize.py (tracked late — the v0.3.3 lock omitted it)

src/okf/frontmatter.ts.why: OKF front matter validation and deriveMinimalFrontmatter, reproduced by pass 1 of scripts/openwiki-finalize.py

src/okf/generated-provenance.ts.why: body-hash snapshot and generated-event reconciliation, reproduced by the provenance pass of scripts/openwiki-finalize.py

src/okf/index-sync.ts.why: synchronizeWikiIndexes, reproduced by pass 2 of scripts/openwiki-finalize.py

notCovered.src/agent/prompts/personal.ts: personal-wiki output mode (outputMode: local-wiki); a different product from repository documentation
notCovered.CODE_SYSTEM_PROMPTS.chat: interactive chat; this port auto-routes between init and update instead
notCovered.--language flag: no slash-command equivalent, so language is omitted from run metadata
notCovered.src/claims/*, src/okf/claim-sources.ts,: grounded claims with machine verification (claims store, evidence resolvers); a prompt-only port cannot provide them, so workers write pages directly
notCovered.src/generation/*: durable resumable page jobs and .run.json persistence; the port runs in one session and plans updates from the last recorded gitHead
notCovered.src/mermaid/*: mermaid fence parse-validation; Python's standard library cannot parse mermaid, and the repository prompts carry no diagram discipline to lose
notCovered.src/integrations/*: upstream's own coding-agent installer; this port is the alternative distribution
